blocking_findings.title: Bare-CR line comment bypasses the pre-resolver import prohibition
blocking_findings.finding: SourcePolicy.skip terminates // and -- comments only at LF. Alloy and the document SourceLexer end them at bare CR too. An open token after CR is therefore skipped by preflight and reaches CompUtil.parseEverything_fromFile before AstPolicy rejects explicit imports. The final rejection is fail-closed for accepted artifacts, but the mandatory no-import-resolution boundary has already been crossed. This can resolve bundled or sandbox-visible module paths and consume parser work outside the declared import-free preflight. No sandbox escape or accepted imported artifact was demonstrated.
blocking_findings.reproducer: Exact source: // comment\ropen util/boolean\nsig A {}\n (\r is one U+000D). SourcePolicy.check returns normally; DocumentEngine later throws DocumentValidationException UNSUPPORTED_FRAGMENT from post-parse import policy.
blocking_findings.verification: Read-only JShell using existing target/classes, target/solver/alloy.jar and target/dependency jars; no rebuild or source edit. Observed PREFLIGHT_ACCEPT and engine UNSUPPORTED_FRAGMENT.
blocking_findings.resolution: End line comments at either CR or LF while preserving exact source bytes; ensure CRLF is consumed consistently. Retain post-parse AstPolicy as defense in depth. Add // and -- cases with CR, LF and CRLF proving explicit open is denied before resolver invocation; comments containing open must remain harmless.

positive_findings: ModuleChecker independently enforces closed shapes, global identity uniqueness, exact nominal columns, lexical binders, unique expression ownership, reachability, bounded depth and predicate dependency acyclicity. Field-order guard is explicit and does not silently reorder accepted candidates.

ModulePrinter plus independent parser/reader/ModuleEquivalence compare operator structure, ordered schemas, multiplicities, calls and command options; ordered AND/OR flattening is limited. Under globally unique checked names, name comparison implements an unambiguous declaration/binder bijection for these printer round trips.
SOURCE uses parser policy first and unsupported syntax falls to TEXT_ONLY without fabricated IR. Authored domain restriction is excluded lexically before enabling the generated field-owner adapter.

Comment transport uses authoritative prior bytes and explicit copy lineage; unavailable map roles are surfaced rather than guessed. Historical revalidation preserves source/module/maps/trivia and independently rechecks structural correspondence.

Accepted analysis resolves source and command descriptor from authorized immutable revision, checks current build-derived policy/source and artifact descriptor binding, and records an accepted key separate from legacy job identity.
DocumentWorker uses fixed sandbox entry point, bounded process exchange and current build identity; no direct non-sandbox production validation route was found in inspected query/mutation boundary.
limitations: This was targeted source review plus one read-only direct-engine probe, not exhaustive execution of all adapters or HTTP/database paths.
The direct-engine JShell probe was deliberately outside the production sandbox to inspect preflight behavior; it does not establish sandbox behavior or escape.
No Maven/npm/build operations or source/test changes were performed. The parent reports159 Java tests; this review does not independently attest their execution.
No Lean-to-runtime refinement, complete parser semantics, G2/G3 closure or commercial acceptance inferred from formal251 or passing finite tests.
